name: Spain (Bourbon ensign, 1701–1760)
description: A white field with the full royal arms of Spain, crowned and surrounded by the collars of the Golden Fleece and the Holy Spirit, in the centre.
history: The white Bourbon ensign flown by Spanish ships and fortresses from the accession of Philip V in 1701, carrying the full royal arms. Charles III modified the arms in 1760, and in 1785 replaced the white ensign, too easily confused with those of the other Bourbon courts, with the red and yellow flag.

features.role: royal arms of the Spanish Bourbons
